summary: Completed iteration 8 backend regression and desktop/mobile UI testing. Hero film layer, coverage globe and all four sector updates passed with no blocked media requests or page console errors. One case-study scroll-stage regression remains: the modal only exposes stages 1–3.

integration_issues.issue: Case-study modal scroll range is capped at 195px (scrollHeight 1037px, clientHeight 842px), so stage 4–7 cannot be reached; scrollTop 285–1000 clamps to 195 and the UI remains at stage 03.

action_items: Adjust case-study modal layout/scroll behavior so all seven story stages are reachable and stage 07 appears at the bottom of the panel.
critical_code_review_comments: The stage calculation supports seven stages, but the modal's max-height/desktop sticky layout leaves only 195px of scrollable range, making four stages functionally inaccessible.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed contact inquiries and status records through the public regression suite; no seeded production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified desktop/mobile load, no horizontal overflow at 390px, hero-film CSS layer without video element, coverage globe routes/UAE/global labels, all four sector status updates, anchors, capability tabs, relationship panel, contact success, mobile nav, and no blocked hero/image media requests. Re-test case-study stages after modal scroll/layout fix.
rca of the issue: The case-study onScroll handler maps scrollTop in 95px increments, but .case-study-panel has max-height: 78vh and its grid/sticky image layout leaves only 195px of actual scroll range at 1920x1080. Therefore the maximum computed stage is floor(195/95)=2, displayed as stage 03, and stages 04–07 are unreachable.
